title: 復健醫學
intro: 中風／脊髓損傷復健、物理治療、職能治療、語言治療與輔具。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Stroke and spinal-cord rehabilitation, physiotherapy, occupational and speech therapy, assistive devices. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 中風後走得更遠：目標還需要什麼？
procedures.titleEn: Walking farther after stroke: what else matters?
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：中風後學員在復健室走得更遠，但仍不敢獨自去住家商店。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A learner walks farther in stroke rehabilitation but avoids the neighbourhood shop.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 測試距離改善，社區活動未恢復。
stages.evidenceEn: Test distance improves while community activity does not.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 區分身體能力與實際參與
choices.en: Distinguish capacity from real-world participation

choices.zh: 把距離改善等同所有目標完成
choices.en: Equate distance gains with every goal achieved

stages.reason: 活動環境也影響實際功能。
stages.reasonEn: The environment also affects real-world function.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把距離改善等同所有目標完成；活動環境也影響實際功能。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Equate distance gains with every goal achieved; The environment also affects real-world function.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 商店途中有台階與人群。
stages.evidenceEn: The route includes steps and crowds.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只在平坦走廊重複同一測試
choices.en: Repeat only the flat-corridor test

choices.zh: 把環境需求納入功能目標
choices.en: Include environmental demands in the goal

stages.reason: 單一場景不能代表所有活動需求。
stages.reasonEn: One setting cannot represent every activity demand.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只在平坦走廊重複同一測試；單一場景不能代表所有活動需求。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Repeat only the flat-corridor test; One setting cannot represent every activity demand.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 兩次測試使用不同輔具。
stages.evidenceEn: Different aids were used in the two tests.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 註記輔具條件後再比較
choices.en: Record aid conditions before comparing

choices.zh: 把全部差異歸因自然恢復
choices.en: Attribute every difference to recovery

stages.reason: 測試條件改變會混入效果。
stages.reasonEn: Changed testing conditions confound interpretation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把全部差異歸因自然恢復；測試條件改變會混入效果。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Attribute every difference to recovery; Changed testing conditions confound interpretation.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 學員最重視能與鄰居見面。
stages.evidenceEn: Meeting neighbours is the learner’s priority.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 以治療師偏好的分數代替本人目標
choices.en: Replace personal goals with the therapist’s preferred score

choices.zh: 共同選擇有意義且可追蹤的目標
choices.en: Agree on meaningful, trackable goals

stages.reason: 復健目標需連結本人生活。
stages.reasonEn: Rehabilitation goals should connect to personal life.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：以治療師偏好的分數代替本人目標；復健目標需連結本人生活。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Replace personal goals with the therapist’s preferred score; Rehabilitation goals should connect to personal life.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班本人目標、輔具條件、環境阻礙與下一次功能觀察。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over personal goals, aid conditions, environmental barriers and the next functional observation.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班本人目標、輔具條件、環境阻礙與下一次功能觀察。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over personal goals, aid conditions, environmental barriers and the next functional observation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班本人目標、輔具條件、環境阻礙與下一次功能觀察。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over personal goals, aid conditions, environmental barriers and the next functional observation.

procedures.title: 說不出不代表聽不懂：失語溝通
procedures.titleEn: Difficulty speaking does not establish poor understanding
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：中風後患者口語表達困難，團隊發現他能用圖片表達偏好。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A patient has speech difficulty after stroke but expresses preferences with pictures.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 口語回答短，但能依指示指向物品。
stages.evidenceEn: Spoken replies are brief but object pointing follows instructions.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把說不出視為完全無法理解
choices.en: Treat limited speech as total lack of understanding

choices.zh: 分別觀察表達與理解
choices.en: Assess expression and comprehension separately

stages.reason: 語言功能不是單一能力。
stages.reasonEn: Language function is not a single ability.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把說不出視為完全無法理解；語言功能不是單一能力。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat limited speech as total lack of understanding; Language function is not a single ability.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 多人同時問話時表現變差。
stages.evidenceEn: Performance worsens when several people ask questions together.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 降低溝通負荷並確認理解
choices.en: Reduce communication load and check understanding

choices.zh: 把變差當成故意拒絕
choices.en: Interpret deterioration as deliberate refusal

stages.reason: 情境負荷可影響溝通表現。
stages.reasonEn: Contextual load can affect communication.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把變差當成故意拒絕；情境負荷可影響溝通表現。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Interpret deterioration as deliberate refusal; Contextual load can affect communication.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 圖片回答與口頭是非回答不一致。
stages.evidenceEn: Picture choices and spoken yes/no responses disagree.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只選團隊想聽到的答案
choices.en: Choose the answer preferred by staff

choices.zh: 使用不同方式交叉確認
choices.en: Cross-check using more than one method

stages.reason: 不一致需澄清而非代答。
stages.reasonEn: Disagreement needs clarification, not substituted answers.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只選團隊想聽到的答案；不一致需澄清而非代答。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Choose the answer preferred by staff; Disagreement needs clarification, not substituted answers.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 家屬習慣代替他回答。
stages.evidenceEn: Family commonly answers on the patient’s behalf.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 保留本人表達時間與協助方式
choices.en: Preserve time and support for personal expression

choices.zh: 所有偏好均由家屬推定
choices.en: Infer all preferences from family

stages.reason: 溝通支持應保留當事人參與。
stages.reasonEn: Communication support should preserve participation.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：所有偏好均由家屬推定；溝通支持應保留當事人參與。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Infer all preferences from family; Communication support should preserve participation.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班可用的表達管道、理解線索、負荷限制與語言治療目標。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over usable communication methods, comprehension clues, load limits and language goals.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班可用的表達管道、理解線索、負荷限制與語言治療目標。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over usable communication methods, comprehension clues, load limits and language goals.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班可用的表達管道、理解線索、負荷限制與語言治療目標。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over usable communication methods, comprehension clues, load limits and language goals.

procedures.title: 肩部活動增加但生活仍困難
procedures.titleEn: More shoulder movement but persistent daily difficulty
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：肩部復健後活動角度增加，學員仍無法完成自己重視的穿衣活動。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: Shoulder movement improves, yet dressing remains difficult.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 活動角度改善，穿衣步驟仍需協助。
stages.evidenceEn: Range improves while dressing still needs help.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 另外分析任務需求與策略
choices.en: Analyse task demands and strategies separately

choices.zh: 以角度代替全部功能評估
choices.en: Replace functional assessment with range alone

stages.reason: 活動範圍與任務完成不是同一結果。
stages.reasonEn: Range and task completion are different outcomes.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：以角度代替全部功能評估；活動範圍與任務完成不是同一結果。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Replace functional assessment with range alone; Range and task completion are different outcomes.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 疼痛與疲倦在一天不同時間改變。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain and fatigue vary during the day.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把所有波動當成缺乏努力
choices.en: Call every fluctuation insufficient effort

choices.zh: 記錄測試時段與症狀條件
choices.en: Record timing and symptom conditions

stages.reason: 症狀條件影響活動表現。
stages.reasonEn: Symptoms affect activity performance.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把所有波動當成缺乏努力；症狀條件影響活動表現。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Call every fluctuation insufficient effort; Symptoms affect activity performance.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 兩次穿衣使用不同鬆緊的衣物。
stages.evidenceEn: Different clothing was used in repeated observations.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 統一或明確註記測試條件
choices.en: Standardise or document test conditions

choices.zh: 直接計算衣物不同造成的療效
choices.en: Count clothing differences as treatment efficacy

stages.reason: 可比較性需要任務條件。
stages.reasonEn: Comparability requires task conditions.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：直接計算衣物不同造成的療效；可比較性需要任務條件。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Count clothing differences as treatment efficacy; Comparability requires task conditions.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 學員想先恢復自行穿外套。
stages.evidenceEn: The learner prioritises putting on a coat.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只追求圖表中最大的活動角度
choices.en: Pursue only the largest angle on a chart

choices.zh: 將本人優先活動列為追蹤目標
choices.en: Track the person’s priority activity

stages.reason: 有意義的功能可指引評估。
stages.reasonEn: Meaningful function guides assessment.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只追求圖表中最大的活動角度；有意義的功能可指引評估。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Pursue only the largest angle on a chart; Meaningful function guides assessment.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班活動、疼痛疲倦時段、衣物條件與本人穿衣目標。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over activity, pain and fatigue timing, clothing conditions and the dressing goal.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班活動、疼痛疲倦時段、衣物條件與本人穿衣目標。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over activity, pain and fatigue timing, clothing conditions and the dressing goal.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班活動、疼痛疲倦時段、衣物條件與本人穿衣目標。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over activity, pain and fatigue timing, clothing conditions and the dressing goal.

procedures.title: 回到工作：疲倦與環境一起評估
procedures.titleEn: Returning to work: assess fatigue and environment together
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：傷病復健後準備復工，學員短時活動良好，長時段後表現下降。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A recovering worker performs well briefly but less well over longer periods.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 短測驗正常，實際工作需要較久時間。
stages.evidenceEn: A brief test is normal but work demands sustained effort.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 正常短測驗保證完整工作能力
choices.en: A normal brief test guarantees full work capacity

choices.zh: 比較持續時間與實際任務
choices.en: Compare duration and real task demands

stages.reason: 測驗涵蓋的能力有範圍。
stages.reasonEn: A test has a limited scope.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：正常短測驗保證完整工作能力；測驗涵蓋的能力有範圍。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: A normal brief test guarantees full work capacity; A test has a limited scope.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 噪音與同時處理多項事務時較困難。
stages.evidenceEn: Noise and competing tasks increase difficulty.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 將環境負荷納入觀察
choices.en: Include environmental load in observations

choices.zh: 認為只是工作態度不佳
choices.en: Assume poor work attitude

stages.reason: 情境需求可能揭露不同限制。
stages.reasonEn: Context may reveal different limitations.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：認為只是工作態度不佳；情境需求可能揭露不同限制。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assume poor work attitude; Context may reveal different limitations.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 學員的疲倦日誌與單次門診不同。
stages.evidenceEn: The fatigue diary differs from one clinic observation.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 丟棄所有本人紀錄
choices.en: Discard the person’s records

choices.zh: 整合重複紀錄並核對條件
choices.en: Integrate repeated records and their conditions

stages.reason: 時間範圍不同可能解釋差異。
stages.reasonEn: Different observation periods may explain disagreement.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：丟棄所有本人紀錄；時間範圍不同可能解釋差異。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Discard the person’s records; Different observation periods may explain disagreement.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 團隊尚未問過本人最重要的工作需求。
stages.evidenceEn: The team has not explored the worker’s priorities.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 共同定義可追蹤的功能目標
choices.en: Jointly define trackable functional goals

choices.zh: 只以是否復工的二分法評估
choices.en: Assess only whether work has resumed

stages.reason: 參與程度與支持需求也重要。
stages.reasonEn: Participation and support needs also matter.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只以是否復工的二分法評估；參與程度與支持需求也重要。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assess only whether work has resumed; Participation and support needs also matter.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班任務時長、情境負荷、日誌限制、本人目標與復評者。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over task duration, contextual load, diary limits, goals and the reassessment owner.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班任務時長、情境負荷、日誌限制、本人目標與復評者。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over task duration, contextual load, diary limits, goals and the reassessment owner.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班任務時長、情境負荷、日誌限制、本人目標與復評者。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over task duration, contextual load, diary limits, goals and the reassessment owner.

procedures.title: 中風復健
procedures.patient: 依課程「中風復健」設定的虛擬情境：Brunnstrom 分期、任務導向訓練與限制誘發運動治療。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Stroke rehabilitation": Brunnstrom stages, task-oriented training and constraint-induced therapy. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 2：任務導向訓練…

procedures.title: 脊髓損傷復健
procedures.patient: 依課程「脊髓損傷復健」設定的虛擬情境：損傷平面功能預測、神經性膀胱腸道與自主神經反射異常。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Spinal cord injury rehabilitation": Functional expectations by level, neurogenic bladder/bowel and autonomic dysreflexia. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 1：損傷平面功能…
關鍵要素 2：神經性膀胱腸…

procedures.title: 腦外傷復健與 Rancho 分級
procedures.patient: 依課程「腦外傷復健與 Rancho 分級」設定的虛擬情境：Rancho Los Amigos、激躁處理與認知復健。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Traumatic brain injury rehabilitation": Rancho Los Amigos levels, agitation and cognitive rehabilitation. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
